items.headline: $NEAR Soars as Bitwise ETF Wins NYSE Arca Listing
items.summary: Bitwise's $NEAR ETF got approved to list and trade on NYSE Arca, sending the token sharply higher as institutional access widens.

items.headline: $ENA: Ethena Adds Equity Perps to USDe Backing
items.summary: Ethena is expanding $USDe's backing strategy into Binance bStocks and short equity perpetuals, a new twist on its basis trade.

items.headline: $ZRO Sued by KelpDAO Over $292M rsETH Exploit
items.summary: KelpDAO sued LayerZero and CEO Bryan Pellegrino, alleging they endorsed in writing the bridge setup behind the $292M rsETH exploit.

items.headline: $ONDO Launches BlackRock-Built Portfolio Tokens
items.summary: Ondo rolled out three onchain portfolio tokens based on BlackRock model strategies, live on Ethereum and BNB Chain for non-US investors.

items.headline: $ME Exploit Scare: $5.7M in NFTs Rescued
items.summary: Legacy Magic Eden approvals exposed $5.7M in NFTs to an exploit before whitehats secured 23,155 tokens. Holders must revoke old approvals.
